A peaceful corner of Bell Lane

COCO Nails & Spa is a peaceful, welcoming nail salon and spa on Bell Lane in Bury. Our highly-qualified technicians cover everything from acrylics and BIAB to hot stone pedicures, manicures and extensions, each set finished to your own specification.

  • Walk-ins welcome
  • Free drinks
  • Free Wi-Fi
  • Wheelchair accessible
  • Address 6 Bell Lane, Bury BL9 6AR
  • Phone 07983 736666
